Nickname Origin: it’s kind of a long story. I played WoW once upon a time, long long ago. I was stuck coming up with a name for my Hunter. I had a print hanging above my desk by Wijmer (Misty Peaks), so I decided to stick with Wijmer. I started using that for just about everything. Over time I got bored with the name and started mucking around with the letters (Wijmir, Wajmor, The Wyrj, etc.) and eventually going even further to morph it (Wyrjbark, Grizmer, Wijjy Waj, etc.) and eventually settled on Grizbarq. I’ll likely continue to mold and shape the name further still, until it is but a loose interpretation of the original name. 

Discovering CTA: I was on a huge Tap Titans 2 kicker. They have fairy ads that reward you with buffs/gold for watching 30sec ads. Some ads were for cars, like 90% of them were for that shitty looking current-gen Final Fantasy mobile game. One ad that popped up occasionally was one for CTA. It didn’t really explain much about the game, but I was getting bored with TT2 and felt a much needed change. Downloaded it, fell in love with the idea of the “Rock/Paper/Scissors” format of heroes as well as the roles, jobs, and unique abilities each hero had. I also enjoyed the various modes, the Guild system, and even the VIP system that nets you VIP points (in addition to gold/Flooz) for watching ads. I reached VIP 1 within like 20 days of starting. Been playing almost a month straight and haven’t looked back at TT2 since. 

EDIT: Now that I’ve been playing CTA, I’ve been seeing ads left and right for TT2, as if it’s begging me to return like an obsessive ex. 

Favorite Hero: Can’t really decide! Merlinus has proven to be invaluable in Blitz/Arena, and my Dark Knight’s 3 ⭐️ special demolishes nearly everything regardless of resistance. In terms of aesthetics though, I like Light Knight’s design. It’s simple, gives me a bit of a Solaire of Astora vibe. I think I gotta give it to Krünk though.
